challenge.method: Rendered and inspected the numbered callout and directives. Checked IBM's later free-form RPG documentation for a counterexample to carrying the V6R1 /FREE example into fully free-form source.
challenge.results: The relevant V6R1 calculation specs have two forms and the example uses a bounded free-form region. IBM's later documentation distinguishes fully free-form source, where these directives are disallowed, from the older column-limited form.

limitations: The modern IBM Docs HTML route denied a direct web open, so the later example was also checked against IBM's accessible developer support article on free-form H, F, D and P statements. Only the frozen V6R1 PDF supplies claim support.
